scripts.build: node apps/web/build.mjs --target web && node apps/web/build.mjs --target mcpapp
scripts.check: node apps/web/build.mjs --target web --check && node apps/web/build.mjs --target mcpapp --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node apps/conector/test.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml
